---
description: Assess the Angular Order Service workshop starter without changing it.
---

Assess `app/angular-order-service` for modernization. Read its source,
configuration, tests and README. Use the recorded baseline and current official
Angular release, compatibility and update documentation as evidence. Inventory
the simulated order API and user-visible behavior. Identify unsupported
versions, deprecated patterns, dependency advisories, migration risks and
unknowns, including monetary precision; do not infer exploitability from an
advisory alone.

Write `assessment/angular-assessment.md` with findings, links, accepted or
deferred recommendations and an Angular 20 → 21 → 22 target. Do not modify
application code or execute an upgrade.
